Chrono Express original generated sound effects
SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0

The 37 WAV files listed below and scripts/generate-sfx.mjs were created for
this project using deterministic mathematical synthesis. No recordings,
downloaded samples, commercial game audio, or external sound libraries were
used. They are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Attribution is not required.

This dedication does NOT apply to the pre-existing sfx-slow.wav,
sfx-freeze.wav, sfx-rewind.wav, sfx-ghost.wav, or the music directory.
Their provenance/licensing is unchanged and was not established by this work.

Regeneration: npm run audio:generate
Encoding: 22,050 Hz, mono, signed 16-bit PCM WAV.
Total new audio: 704,144 bytes. Short PCM assets avoid codec-specific
dependencies and lossy transient artifacts; longer existing music stays MP3.
